registration_scope: Local prospective specification written before study execution; not an externally registered protocol.
asset_split_rule: First 20 IDs ranked by SHA-256 of energy-study-v1|asset_id; labels, sites and scores do not enter selection.
study_threshold_selection: Lowest predictive replay total cost on the 60 training assets during validation only; tie chooses higher threshold. Never use held-out asset labels for selection.
calibration: Platt logistic mapping on clipped logit(raw risk), C=1000000, fitted separately for each model using seed77 validation-period labels only; report Brier/log loss and reliability bins. Do not apply raw-score dispatch thresholds to calibrated scores.
external_execution_order: Fit both models, select study threshold, and fit calibration maps before generating or evaluating seeds101/202/303. Report every declared seed.

bootstrap.cost_contrast: fixed_90_day minus predictive, paired within asset, 91-day sums annualized by365.25/91

limitations: The seed42 asset split is retrospective because the prior portfolio benchmark was already inspected.
External fleets use the same synthetic generator family, not field data or an independently specified failure process.
Bootstrap intervals are conditional synthetic resampling ranges, not field confidence intervals or deployment ROI probabilities.
